evidence.excerpt: Bartoš has expressed interest in collaborating with IoT hardware or industrial wireless companies at NTP Novi Sad that are preparing products for EU market entry and need access to accredited-quality pre-compliance testing infrastructure. He prefers collaborations that generate research questions suitable for student theses rather than purely routine testing work.
